entities.name: Selvala of Alberon
entities.description: Elven scout and high court member of Paliano on Fiora; killed King Brago to end his suffering and later joined the Freestriders on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: Ambitious young count who became king and Selvala's close friend; suffered from an incurable disease.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: Priesthood that prolonged Brago's life and threw Selvala into the dungeons.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: Goblin dungeon keeper who released Selvala to kill Muzzio.

entities.name: Black Rose
entities.description: Group that usurped the crown of Paliano.

entities.name: Captain Adriana
entities.description: Captain of the Guard who approached Selvala to help build the Republic.

entities.name: Republic of Paliano
entities.description: Republic built after the monarchy was removed.

entities.name: Charter
entities.description: Document drafted by Selvala and Brago.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: Group on Thunder Junction that Selvala joined.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Selvala reached through an Omenpath.

events.summary: Selvala and Brago rise in Fiora's ruling class and draft the Charter.
events.quote: Together with Brago, she drafted the Charter.

events.summary: Selvala kills the incurably ill, over-treated King Brago with a dagger as an act of mercy.
events.quote: Selvala ended his suffering with a dagger through his heart.

events.summary: The Custodi throw Selvala into the dungeons for murder.
events.quote: the Custodi threw her into the dungeons for murder

events.summary: Grenzo releases Selvala to kill Muzzio; she frees the constructs in his tunnels and leaves the High City.
events.quote: Selvala left the High City and went back to the wild places far below and far beyond.

events.summary: Kaya kills Brago's spirit and the Black Rose usurps the crown.
events.quote: Brago's spirit was killed by the planeswalker Kaya

events.summary: Captain Adriana approaches Selvala to help remove the monarchy and build the Republic.
events.quote: help get rid of the monarchy and help build the Republic of Paliano

events.summary: Selvala travels to Thunder Junction via an Omenpath and joins the Freestriders.

relations.note: close friend who rose with him
relations.quote: Together with her close friend, the ambitious young Count Brago
Selvala ended his suffering with a dagger through his heart.
Brago's spirit was killed by the planeswalker Kaya
in a bid to kill the artificer Muzzio
